svg.text: FESTIVAL OF TRADITIONAL SPORTS · UNIVERSAL QR LIVE HUB · UI/UX SPECIFICATION
One QR code is printed everywhere. Every scan opens the same Event Live Hub; the visitor then chooses what they need.
THE SAME QR IS DISPLAYED AT
The Live Hub updates automatically. The printed QR is never changed.
The QR is a permanent physical gateway into the continuously updated event platform. No context-specific QR behaviour.
